headline: South Bow Reports $99M Third-Quarter Earnings
summary: South Bow reported third-quarter earnings of $99 million, amounting to 47 cents per share compared with 45 cents per share during the same period last year.
why: Earnings reports from midstream energy infrastructure companies provide insight into pipeline throughput volumes and cash flow stability.

impacts.why: Higher per-share earnings reflect improved quarterly financial performance.
